artists.biography: Christian Berishaj, known professionally as JMSN (pronounced "Jameson"), is an American singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and record producer. Born in Dallas and raised in Detroit, JMSN has been an influential figure in the contemporary R&B and alternative music scenes.

perplexity.description:
…it's only about u if you think it is. is JMSN's ninth studio album, released in October 2025 on his independent White Room Records label. The project emerged from the unexpected viral success of the single "Soft Spot," which catalyzed a creative reassessment for the Detroit-based artist. Comprising ten tracks written primarily around the time of that breakthrough moment but recorded and mixed over two years, the album represents a deliberate shift toward rawer, heavier, and slower sonic territory. JMSN challenged himself to build arrangements around bass lines and use fewer instrumental tracks, creating more breathing room and emotional space than his previous work.

The album showcases JMSN's refined mastery of blending throwback R&B with modern electronic textures, exploring themes of heartbreak, obsession, and vulnerability with surgical precision. Standout tracks like "I Don't Even Think About U" exemplify this approach—slow-burning and soulful, the song rides warm basslines and subtle guitar while lyrically dramatizing denial through domestic imagery (burnt toast, week-old roses, glimpses of a familiar car). The production incorporates flanged guitars and faint background vocals that swirl like intrusive thoughts, capturing regret without melodrama. Across its 42-minute runtime, …it's only about u if you think it is. balances the album's funk and soul foundation with introspective, emotionally complex songwriting that deepens JMSN's reputation as a craftsman of contemporary R&B.
